summary: Automatic update notices now open centered over the fully active PyCUPS main window.
changelog: Waits until the newly opened main window is both mapped and active before presenting an automatic optional update notice.
Keeps the update window transient for the main window so the desktop compositor can center it correctly instead of positioning half of it outside the screen.
Leaves manual update checks and standalone mandatory-update behavior unchanged.
Adds regression coverage for mapped-but-inactive startup windows and deferred presentation.
